arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Unmatured redemptions (in millions of nominal dollars)
nominal = {
    'Jan 1970': 284,
    'Feb 1970': 295,
    'Mar 1970': 375
}

# BLS CPI-U values (1982-84=100) for Jan-Mar 1970
cpi = {
    'Jan 1970': 59.8,
    'Feb 1970': 60.4,
    'Mar 1970': 60.8
}

# Base month: March 1970
cpi_mar_1970 = 60.8

# Convert nominal to real March 1970 dollars
# Real = Nominal * (CPI_base / CPI_nominal)
real = {}
for month in nominal:
    real[month] = nominal[month] * (cpi_mar_1970 / cpi[month])
    
print("Conversion to March 1970 real dollars:")
for month in real:
    print(f"{month}: {nominal[month]} nominal -> {real[month]:.4f} real")

# Now perform linear regression (real redemptions vs month index)
# Month indices: Jan=1, Feb=2, Mar=3
import numpy as np

x = np.array([1, 2, 3])  # month indices
y = np.array([real['Jan 1970'], real['Feb 1970'], real['Mar 1970']])

# Linear regression using numpy
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)

print(f"\nLinear Regression Results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope:.4f} millions per month")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.4f} millions")

# Round to nearest hundredths
slope_rounded = round(slope, 2)
intercept_rounded = round(intercept, 2)

print(f"\nRounded to hundredths:")
print(f"Slope: {slope_rounded}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept_rounded}")

print(f"\nOutput format: [{slope_rounded}, {intercept_rounded}]")
EOF
